newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler lowers Q3 output forecast by 2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler lowers Q3 output forecast by 2 pct.

text.p: Chrysler Corp. on Thursday lowered its third quarter production forecast from the previous estimate by 9,000 units, or two percent, to 576,900 cars and trucks.
Chrysler reduced its passenger car estimate by 10,400 units to 144,600, and boosted its truck forecast by 1,400 units to 432,300 units.
Chrysler's new third quarter output forecast is nine percent below its 1996 third quarter production of 631,000 vehicles.
